about.title: La Habra Heights Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: La Habra Heights is a small hillside community of about 5,454 people in Los Angeles County, and a loss here is felt across neighborhoods, not just within one home. Public records show 12 injury collisions and 14 people hurt on local roads in 2025, with no traffic deaths recorded that year. Wrongful death claims in this community are not limited to the roadway, though. Harbor Boulevard, Hacienda Road, East Road, and Harbor Road carry the most reported collisions, but families also come to us after a fall on someone else's property, a medical error, a defective product, or a workplace incident. Under California law, a wrongful death case is a civil action, entirely separate from any criminal proceeding, and it belongs to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then to certain dependents and heirs. The clock runs two years from the date of death, and shorter if a public agency may be responsible. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect you with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why La Habra Heights Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing to the spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can explain where your family fits before anyone files paperwork.

items.title: The deadline is shorter than many expect
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window narrows considerably when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Early contact protects that timeline.

items.title: Losses that go beyond funeral bills
items.desc: Recoverable damages can include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. A contingency-fee attorney pursues these without an upfront cost to you.

items.question: There were no traffic deaths recorded in La Habra Heights in 2025. Does that mean wrongful death claims are rare here?
items.answer: Public records do show zero traffic fatalities for 2025 alongside 12 injury collisions on roads like Harbor Boulevard and Hacienda Road. Wrongful death claims, however, arise from many situations beyond driving, including medical errors, unsafe premises, defective products, and workplace incidents. If a preventable death touched your family, the cause matters less than whether someone else's negligence played a role.

items.question: The person responsible is facing criminal charges. Do we still need a civil case?
items.answer: Yes, the two are separate. A criminal case is brought by the prosecutor and focuses on punishment, while a wrongful death action is brought by the family and focuses on the losses you have suffered. The civil case can move forward regardless of how the criminal matter ends, and the two-year filing deadline continues to run in the meantime.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect us with an attorney?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network take wrongful death cases on contingency, which means there is no attorney fee unless a recovery is made. Your first conversation is simply a chance to understand your options.
